sentences.text:
State Government is unable to produce the copy of extension for perusal of this Court on the next date, appropriate order would be passed by this Court on the issue whether the acquisition proceedings have lapsed or not in view of there being no extension granted by appropriate Government beyond the period of initial twelve months with effect from 1st January, 2014 or 20th March, 2015.
